text:
kevin_cs: Meridian Payments opened an onboarding request: candidate reranker for POS suggestions + 512-dim embeddings export. Pilot: hosted API for 4 weeks, KPI: p99 <= 75ms for top-10 rerank (avg 60 tokens). Compliance: no raw PANs, hashed order ids only.

ops-meridian: correct. We'll provide 1.2k labeled reorder examples and plan to expand to 6k after pilot. Need synchronous scoring + occasional bulk embedding dumps for analytics.

maya_solutions: thanks. Can you drop a 200-row seed CSV so we can start offline eval? we'll need golden ranks for NDCG and per-merchant slices.

ops-meridian: uploading seed now via SFTP. Labels are preliminary — partner labeling final in 10 days.

lex_sre: perf note: 75ms p99 for 10-candidate rerank is tight but possible with a single-pass scorer that processes all candidates together on a quantized 7B or a distilled 3B. We'll run both concat and pairwise benches.

paula_privacy: privacy checklist: confirm client-side redaction of PANs, hashed mapping with customer salt only, and log-redact enabled. DPA required before any persistent embedding export. I'll draft the DPA.

maya_solutions: action items:
1) receive seed CSV (ops-meridian) ETA 24h
2) offline eval (200 seed -> NDCG, initial fairness slices) (maya_solutions) ETA 3d
3) perf microbenchmarks (lex_sre) ETA 4d
4) DPA + redaction checklist (paula_privacy) ETA 5d
5) schedule integration call (kevin_cs) propose Mon 10am PT

ops-meridian: seed uploaded: meridian_rerank_seed_v1.csv (420KB) sftp@incoming 2230012349

upload-bot: Upload received: meridian_rerank_seed_v1.csv (420KB) 2230012349

lex_sre: perf command for concat scorer:
```
./bench_rerank --model ./models/7b-concat-q8 --batch 12 --seq 80 --warmup 250 --measure p99
```

maya_solutions: eval thresholds: NDCG@10 uplift >= 0.05 and merchant-slice delta < 0.03. If metrics fail, iterate features or try distilled 3B.

kevin_cs: noted. Renewal risk: high upside if pilot reduces false positives in fraud filtering; priority = high. Flag blockers here.

paula_privacy: will post DPA draft in 48h. pls confirm no raw order ids in uploads.

ops-meridian: confirmed, no raw order ids. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
